component.name: FlashDevice
component.description: Monitoring Flash Health of Gateway. Flash devices are detected by the gateway during boot. Flash wear monitoring can be enabled per device.

parameter.name: FlashDeviceNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

object.name: FlashDevice.{i}.
object.description: Represents the eMMC or NAND flash device present in the gateway.

parameter.name: FlashType
parameter.description: Indicates flash device type.

parameter.name: Name
parameter.description: Name for the flash device.

parameter.name: Path
parameter.description: System Path to the flash device folder based on the uri scheme {{bibref|RFC8089|The file URI Scheme}}.

parameter.name: HardwareVersion
parameter.description: Hardware version of the flash device.

object.name: FlashDevice.{i}.Health.
object.description: This gives health status of the flash device(agnostic of NAND or eMMC).

parameter.name: Enabled
parameter.description: Indicates whether flash device monitoring is enabled for this device.

parameter.name: MonitoringStatus
parameter.description: This provides monitoring status of the flash device.

enumeration.description: Monitoring disabled for the flash device.
Flash monitoring is not supported for this flash device.

parameter.name: HealthStatus
parameter.description: Health Status of monitored flash device.

enumeration.description: Lifetime of the Flash Device is limited.

parameter.name: EMMCPreEoLInfo
parameter.description: Overall pre-EOL status information for reserved blocks as specified in bibref|JEDEC84-B50|Section 7.4.21.

enumeration.description: Consumed less than 80% of the reserved blocks.

parameter.name: LifeTimeAState
parameter.description: Life time state reflected by the averaged wear out of memory of Type A relative to its maximum estimated device life time. bibref|JEDEC84-B50|Section 7.4.20.

enumeration.description: Indicates NormalLife of the flash device. Percentage of wear out further defined by {{param|LifeTimeAPercent}}.

parameter.name: LifeTimeAPercent
parameter.description: Device lifetime in {{units}} represented by the average wear of Type A memory, relative to its maximum estimated lifetime, when {{param|LifeTimeAState}} is Normal, see bibref|JEDEC84-B50|Section 7.4.20.

parameter.name: LifeTimeBState
parameter.description: Life time state reflected by the averaged wear out of memory of Type B relative to its maximum estimated device life time. bibref|JEDEC84-B50|Section 7.4.19.

enumeration.description: Indicates NormalLife of the flash device. Percentage of wear out further defined by {{param|LifeTimeBPercent}}.

parameter.name: LifeTimeBPercent
parameter.description: Device lifetime in {{units}} represented by the average wear of Type B memory, relative to its maximum estimated lifetime, when {{param|LifeTimeAState}} is Normal, see bibref|JEDEC84-B50|Section 7.4.19.

parameter.name: LifeTimeAHex
parameter.description: Raw DEVICE_LIFE_TIME_EST_TYP_A [268] output as per bibref|JEDEC84-B50|Section 7.4.20. This field shows an estimated device lifetime based on the average memory wear of Type A compared to its maximum expected lifetime.

parameter.name: LifeTimeBHex
parameter.description: Raw DEVICE_LIFE_TIME_EST_TYP_B output as per bibref|JEDEC84-B50|Section 7.4.19. This field shows an estimated device lifetime based on the average memory wear of Type B compared to its maximum expected lifetime.

parameter.name: LifeTimeAThreshold
parameter.description: Threshold value for {{param|LifeTimeAHex}}. If the {{param|LifeTimeAHex}} value crosses this threshold, set {{param|HealthStatus}} as Critical.

parameter.name: LifeTimeBThreshold
parameter.description: Threshold value for {{param|LifeTimeBHex}}. If the {{param|LifeTimeBHex}} value crosses this threshold, set {{param|HealthStatus}} as Critical.

parameter.name: PreEolThreshold
parameter.description: Threshold value for {{param|EMMCPreEoLInfo}}. If the {{param|EMMCPreEoLInfo}} exceeds this threshold, set {{param|HealthStatus}} as Critical.

parameter.name: TotalBadBlocks
parameter.description: Total Bad Blocks if the flash is a NAND type.

parameter.name: TotalGoodBlocks
parameter.description: Total Good Blocks if the flash is a NAND type.

parameter.name: BadBlocksThreshold
parameter.description: Threshold value for Maximum Bad Blocks if the flash is NAND. If {{param|TotalBadBlocks}} exceeds this threshold, set {{param|HealthStatus}} as Critical.

event.name: HealthStatus!
event.description: This event is triggered when the flash device health status exceeds the configured threshold. If {{param|Enabled}} is {{true}}, the event occurs when the parameter value exceeds the threshold for any of the following parameters: {{param|LifeTimeAThreshold}} exceeds {{param|LifeTimeAPercent}}, {{param|LifeTimeBThreshold}} exceeds {{param|LifeTimeBPercent}}, {{param|PreEolThreshold}} exceeds {{param|EMMCPreEoLInfo}} in case of eMMC flash device, or {{param|TotalBadBlocks}} exceeds {{param|BadBlocksThreshold}} in case of NAND flash device.

parameter.name: FlashDeviceName
parameter.description: Name of the flash device associated with this event. {{param|##.FlashDevice.{i}.Name}}.
